name: Ability
summary: The ability rows the game reads through AbilityTable_GetRow, loaded lazily and cached. The columns are not all decoded.

behavior.text: UIText_ResolveCategoryRow sends the category 'Ability' to table 0x27 (39).
AbilityTable_GetRow reads this same table (its page names the Ability NXD row but not the id).

notes: NXD tables are loaded through the shared registry (NxdRegistry_Find by table id) and read with NxdTable_GetRowById or a key lookup; the file format is described by the NXD format records.

name: AbilityActionRecords
summary: The action record of each action ability, copied into a writable table on first use. Ids from 368 up (the passive abilities) have no action record.

behavior.text: AbilityAction_GetRecord returns the working table + 20 * id and null above 0x16F.

name: AbilityAux
summary: The per-ability auxiliary records: classic JP cost, learn percent and two flag fields, with an extra category-specific record for each id.

behavior.text: record layout is u16 classic JP cost, u8 learn percent, u8 flags3, u32 flags4.
ids below 0x170 are category 0 with the per-ability action record as the extra pointer; ids from 0x170 are categories 1..8 with small byte tables.

name: AbilityKind1_ItemByAbility
summary: The Item-command table: 14 bytes, ability 368 + i maps to item 240 + i (items 240..253). It carries item ids, not abilities, and it is the only table that pairs an Item-command ability with its item.

name: AbilityKind2_ThrowCategory
summary: The Throw table: 12 equip-category bytes, ability 382 + i maps to one category. It stores categories, not item ids; an item is throwable when its record's equipment category matches a row for one of the unit's throw abilities.

name: BattleRangeMarks
summary: Range-mark array: 512 records of 5 bytes, index x + y * width + 256 * layer (layer 1 at +0x500). Byte 0 = in reach (a spread value or 1), byte 1 = spread frontier; written by the BattleRange_* builders, read by BattleRange_FlagTargetTiles.

name: BattleTiles
summary: The battle map tile table: flags and movement cost per tile, filled by the map setup from the map's level record.

name: BattleUnits
summary: The live battle unit table: hit points, magic points, tile, facing, charge time and action words.

name: C_Mes_Id_Sample
summary: The battle message text table: CMesId_GetText reads one row by message id and the registry result is cached in g_CMesIdTable.

behavior.text: CMesId_GetText calls NxdRegistry_Find with id 172 and keeps the result; a missing row gives null.

notes: NXD tables are loaded through the shared registry (NxdRegistry_Find by table id) and read with NxdTable_GetRowById or a key lookup; the file format is described by the NXD format records.

name: CharaRectSizeTable
summary: Width and height of a frame rectangle by its size code, in 8-pixel units (width at 2 * code, height at 2 * code + 4 words): read by CharaRender_DrawFrame.

name: ChargeMotionPairs
summary: 2 bytes per charge type of g_AbilityAnim: +0 the motion sub_140206C14 sets, +1 the motion BattleAnim_SetChargeMotion sets (each + 1; 0 = none)

name: ClutFadeStep32
summary: Step table of the 32-step palette fade, same layout.

name: ClutFadeStep8
summary: Step table of the 8-step palette fade: row = distance + 31, entry = how far the channel moves on that step; the entries of a row add up to the distance.

name: CommandKind
summary: Command id to command kind: index 6 is 1 (Item), index 20 is 2 (Throw), and the battle range and action builders switch on the value.

name: ErrandActive
summary: The eight active errand slot records, nine bytes each: flags, errand id, town and the three dispatched unit ids.

name: ErrandDelay
summary: The per-errand delay byte, one per errand id 0..95, saved with the game.

name: FaceG2dEntryByFace
summary: g2d (pack) entry number per face number 0..205 for the HD layer (row 0 -1, rows 155..158 -1); four readers, each bounding the face with 0xCD.

name: FastForwardMultipliers
summary: Game steps per displayed frame by fast-forward level: 1, 3, 5 (GlobalWork_GetSpeedMultiplier).

name: FastForwardStates
summary: Whether fast-forward is allowed in each battle state; filled from the GameModeTypes NXD table.

behavior.text: starts as all 1, then loaded from GameModeTypes (table 88) row byte +16.

name: GameModeTypes
summary: Per game-mode flags. The only use recorded here: a byte at row +16 says whether fast-forward is allowed in a battle state.

behavior.text: the fast-forward state table is filled with 1, then loaded from this table's row byte +16 (see g_FastForwardStateTable).

notes: NXD tables are loaded through the shared registry (NxdRegistry_Find by table id) and read with NxdTable_GetRowById or a key lookup; the file format is described by the NXD format records.

name: GUIFontSlots
summary: Per-UIFontType render slots (16 B each): byte +145 'loaded', signed byte at 16*(id+9) = renderer font slot.

name: HdSheetEntryBySlot
summary: HD sheet first-entry numbers per sheet slot; unit slots 20 to 28 follow pool index 0 to 8 and index 29 belongs to pool index 9; -1 means not set.

name: HdSheetGroups
summary: The battle HD layer's 20 sheet groups (21144 bytes each): one sheet entry and up to 128 textures per group.

name: HdSlotClut
summary: Palette id of each single-texture slot of the battle HD layer.

name: HdSlotEntry
summary: Sheet entry of each single-texture slot of the battle HD layer (-1 none): the cache key of HdLayer_BuildTextures with g_HdSlotClut.

name: InventoryCounts
summary: The party's inventory: one count per item id 0..260, saved with the game. Written by Inventory_AddCount, Inventory_AddWithOverflow, Inventory_ReturnItem, the starting items and the event and battle code.

name: Item
summary: The item rows (the Item-en table), read through ItemTable_GetRow and ItemTable_GetRowById and used by the text resolver for the category 'Item'. The item records the game keeps in the executable are a separate table.

behavior.text: ItemTable_GetRow caches table 45 (0x2D); UIText_ResolveCategoryRow sends the category 'Item' to the same id.

notes: NXD tables are loaded through the shared registry (NxdRegistry_Find by table id) and read with NxdTable_GetRowById or a key lookup; the file format is described by the NXD format records.

name: ItemAttributes
summary: The equipment attribute records: stat bonuses, move and jump bonuses, status bytes and elements.

name: ItemNewFlags
summary: Two flag bytes per item id 0..260, set at a new game; I: the shop 'new item' badges (byte 1 cleared when the item is first sold, byte 0 when it is first obtained). The first 522 bytes of a 1007-byte block whose tail holds the four Poachers' Den (poach) arrays; g_InventoryCounts begins one byte after it.

name: ItemRecords
summary: The item records the executable keeps for equipment and chemist data: ids 0..255 in one block, ids 256..260 in a second block of five. Item_GetRecord is the only code that addresses them.

behavior.text: ids below 0x100 return the first block + 12 * id; ids 0x100 and above return the second block + 12 * (id - 256).
there is no upper bound check in Item_GetRecord.

name: ItemShopMask
summary: Which shops sell which item: two bytes per item id 0..0xFF, a mask word whose bit for shop s is 0x8000 >> s. A constant table in read-only data; no code writes it and it is never saved.

name: Job
summary: The job rows (the Job-en table), read through JobTable_GetRow. The stock job table in the executable is a separate table.

behavior.text: JobTable_GetRow caches table 46 (0x2E); it returns null when the row is missing.

notes: NXD tables are loaded through the shared registry (NxdRegistry_Find by table id) and read with NxdTable_GetRowById or a key lookup; the file format is described by the NXD format records.

name: JobAbilityPairList
summary: 146 entries of 8 bytes (word 0 = job, word 1 = skillset or ability id, words 2..3 unused by the producers); a list ends at the entry whose word 1 is 0xFFFF. sub_14000E114 initialises all 146 (0, 0xFFFF).

name: JobCommand
summary: The job command rows (the JobCommand-en table), read through JobCommandTable_GetRow.

behavior.text: JobCommandTable_GetRow caches table 41 (0x29); UIText_ResolveCategoryRow sends the category 'JobCommand' to the same id.

notes: NXD tables are loaded through the shared registry (NxdRegistry_Find by table id) and read with NxdTable_GetRowById or a key lookup; the file format is described by the NXD format records.

name: JobNeedLevelRows
summary: 12 B/row; row r = requirement for job index r+1 (nibble-packed required job levels). Row 19 = index 20 (ours; stock Dark Knight Lv8 x4), row 20 = index 21 (Onion Knight). 22 rows.

name: JobTable
summary: The stock job table: skillset, growth, statuses, elements and two script bytes.

name: LookPool
summary: The 15 look pool records (stride 0x32D6); byte +0 is the claim, byte +1 the sprite low byte.

name: LookPoolFaceValue
summary: Battle face value per look pool record 0..9: sub_14026E838 stores the scene unit's sprite byte; cleared to -1 by sub_140210AF0, saved and restored by sub_140304BEC; ten readers use it as a face number behind the 0xCD cap (turn panels, unit status, deployment icons, dialogue face slots).

name: MonsterFaceIndexByJob
summary: Face record index per monster job 94..141 (values 62 to 77, three jobs per family); Unit_GetFaceIndex reads it through the virtual base 0x140715378, 392 bytes inside the HD sheet entry table before it (2026-11-08).

name: MoveBlockers
summary: Up to 16 entries of 7 bytes, one per other unit on the map (record MoveBlockerRecord); an unused entry has id 0xFF.

name: MoveTerrainCost
summary: Movement cost per terrain type for the unit being built (0xFF = cannot enter), copied by Battle_MoveRangeSetup from one of the six sets of g_MoveTerrainCostSets and adjusted for weather and abilities.

name: MoveTerrainCostSets
summary: Six constant cost sets by terrain type: walking, open (Fly / Teleport), float, water (two modes), one more water mode, lava walking. 0 = the weather cost, 0xFF = cannot enter.

name: MoveTileFlags
summary: Per-tile flag byte of the move-range builder: 0x01 frontier, 0x02 one-axis slope, 0x04 occupied, 0x08 unit that can be stepped onto, 0x10 standable, 0x20 mountable ally, 0x40 steep, 0x80 blocked.

name: PoachCount
summary: Poach count per type, 97 bytes based at the badge block plus 522; the poach add routine clamps each byte to 99.

name: PoachersDenStock
summary: Poachers' Den stock: one count per item id 0..260 (PoachersDen_AddStock adds to it, clamped 0..255); the shop list builder Shop_BuildItemList lists the ids with stock when the shop id is 100 or above. Saved with the game.

name: PoachItem
summary: The poach rows (the PoachItem-en table), read through PoachTable_GetRowById.

behavior.text: UIText_ResolveCategoryRow sends the category 'PoachItem' to table 0xEC (236).

notes: NXD tables are loaded through the shared registry (NxdRegistry_Find by table id) and read with NxdTable_GetRowById or a key lookup; the file format is described by the NXD format records.

name: PoachNewFlags
summary: Two new-flag bytes per poach type at the badge block plus 813; a new game fills them with 0x0101 and the badge routine clears the high byte.

name: PoachOrder
summary: The player-visible order of collected poach types, 97 bytes at the badge block plus 619; maintained together with the sort list.

name: PoachSort
summary: The user reordering of the poach types, 97 bytes at the badge block plus 716.

name: PortraitCodes
summary: The portrait code words, one per portrait number. The executable holds six identical copies, each read by different code; four are named here. Copy A of the portrait code words (one of six identical copies), read by PartyUnit_BuildJobRecord.

name: ReactionGates
summary: One byte per reaction id: the reaction executor refuses an id whose byte has 1 in its low two bits.

name: RuntimeJobList
summary: uint16[48]: job id (low 13 bits) | 0x2000 locked | 0x4000 released by another member (mode 3) / current (mode 2); 0xFFFF ends it.

name: SceneTaskSlots
summary: Nine scene-task data records of 0xA8 bytes, parsed from u16 token streams during the battle map setup and captured in a kind-1 snapshot.

name: SceneUnitSlots
summary: The 16 scene-unit records (stride 0x548); the in-use dword is 8 bytes before each.

name: StatusGroupMasks
summary: The ten party-wide status group masks, five bytes each: a group test ANDs these bytes against the unit status bytes at +0x61..+0x65.

name: StatusIconFlags
summary: The per-status flag words the status panel update reads: index status+1, no bound check. Entries past 40 exist, so a forty-first status reads a meaningful but unintended value.

name: TextPools
keys: a text id's five kind bits
summary: The thirty-two text pool pointers the generic text decoder indexes by a text id's kind bits.

name: UnitEquipOverride
summary: Five override equipment words per unit, ten bytes per unit index: when the pair is non-zero the equip pickers use it in place of the unit record's own hand words.

name: UnitLookPoolIndex
summary: Look pool index of each battle unit by its unit index (+444): written by sub_14026EB74 when it builds the unit's scene unit, read back by it on the resume path (load mode 1) and by sub_1401D46B0; inside the battle snapshot region at 0x1408167A0.

name: UnitSceneSlotIndex
summary: Scene-unit slot of each battle unit by its unit index (+444), -1 none: written by sub_14026EB74 (a slot taken by another unit clears that unit's entry) and sub_14026A048, cleared by sub_140210AF0, read on the resume path; inside the battle snapshot region.
